text: G, A, R, H. *No word possible*|with this one.
So I'll just park it|at the bottom.
N, S, P, E. Drop it|right beside it...
*GAP!* +30. And that was|the *best possible drop*.
O, H, R, I. Turn it...|and drop.
*ROE!* +30.|But the best was 60.
N, D, O, E. The best drop|for this one is *720*?!
Turning it round and round...|I can't see it.
Still looking.|Where is that word?
No word. *Streak gone.*|720 missed. Ouch.
Y, H, A, R.|Best possible: 360. Let's find it.
*RAND, RAN, AND!* Combo x3,|+360. *Best possible drop!*
Three in a row. Two more|for the *streak bonus*...
*TENS* and *TEN!* +180.|*STREAK BONUS +300!*
900 and an empty board.|E, H, I, R: no word possible.
H, T, D, E.|Best possible: 120.
*RID* and *TIE!* +120.|Past *1,000*!
S, L, N, E.|Only 30 on offer here.
*LEE!* Best possible drop again.
Last block. N, G, I, R.|Best possible: 30.
Turning it...|turning it...
No word on the last one.|Oh well.
*1,050* on my first try.|New best for today!
